title: Gold Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: Explains how to transfer funds from a Gold Account to an external bank: add and verify the external bank in Transfers, select Gold Account as source, choose the destination, enter an amount up to $25,000 per day, submit, then monitor status. External transfers typically complete in 1 business day; Gold has transfer fees and external banks may charge separate fees.
